text:
alex: Quick question — noticed a confusing state while testing tenant onboarding. If a tenant-admin creates a role that grants route-level `full_access` and also sets a quota override on that route, the Console doesn't surface that this can effectively bypass the tenant-level quota. Should we warn, block, or show an effective-quota preview? cc @maya :eyes:

maya: Yea I've seen that in staging. We intentionally supported route-scoped overrides for enterprise use, but the UI currently treats it as a simple checkbox. We should at minimum show a non-blocking warning with the effective numbers. Telemetry is also fuzzy — quota events are attributed to tenant only, so it's hard to tell which override caused a spike.

jon: From the API/telemetry side we emit a quota evaluation event. current event shape (simplified):

```
{
  "event":"quota_evaluator.hit",
  "scope":"tenant", // or "route"
  "tenant_id":"t-123",
  "route":"/v1/generate",
  "effective_limit":10000,
  "remaining":523
}
```

We can add `role_id` + `override_origin` fields if that helps the Console map warnings -> role. No perf impact.

sam: UX options: 1) inline banner on role-create/update when override != null with a short explanation and link to docs. 2) pre-check modal that shows "effective quotas" across tenant+route before you save. 3) block creation unless tenant-admin also signs-off (probably too heavy). I vote for option 2 for clarity.

lina: Agree on 2. For rollout: canary the warning/modal to 10% of orgs, capture events: `role_warning_shown`, `role_warning_dismissed`, `role_warning_confirmed` + `role_save_attempt`. We can then tune language. Also add a small CTA: "Preview effective quota" that shows a per-route heatmap.

deploy-bot: Canary flag `rbac_quota_warning_modal` created and assigned to 10% of production orgs. Config: `rollout: 10%`, `start: 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z`.

alex: Sounds good. Jon — can you add `role_id` + `override_origin` to the event and a short mapping doc so Console can join? Maya & Sam — can you sketch a 1-screen mock for the modal (effective numbers + short expl + confirm/dismiss) by EOD? Lina — I'll coordinate rollout plan and telemetry dashboards (per-route, per-role).

jon: Yep, I'll add the fields and send a tiny spec in the next PR. Event names I propose: `quota_eval_hit` with tags: `scope`, `role_id`, `override_origin`.

maya: On it — I can whip up a Figma frame and share a link here later.

sam: I'll write the microcopy and the docs snippet to explain "why this matters". We should call out enterprise contracts where overrides are normal. :memo:

alex: Nice. TL;DR: add a preview modal for role-based overrides, emit richer telemetry, canary rollout flag. I'll own rollout coordination. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

lina: One more ask — let's ensure the dashboard filters can show "requests attributed to route overrides" so CS can troubleshoot billing questions. Add to backlog?

alex: Added to backlog under "RBAC telemetry -> route-override attribution".

sam: small nit: consider `aria-live` for the modal so screen readers get the warning copy. Accessibility check when you mock, @maya.

maya: Good call, will include.

alex: End of thread — ping me if anything blocks.
